# PyExplorer

> PyExplorer is an innovative educational game developed in ReactJS, specially created to teach Python programming in a gamified and engaging way for children and teenagers (8 to 15 years old). It uses modern web technologies like Pyodide (WebAssembly) to execute Python code directly in the browser.

Important notes:
- The platform features 4 Epic Sagas and 18 Worlds covering everything from basic concepts to APIs and Data manipulation.
- Includes advanced gamification with stars, coins, achievements, daily streaks, dynamic missions, and a virtual store.
- Supports 8 interactive question types, including multiple choice, code filling, Parsons problems, and visual Turtle challenges.
- PyExplorer functions as a PWA, allowing offline play, and includes an embedded Monaco Editor for writing Python code.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://pyexplorer.com.br/): The landing page and main entry point.
- [Learn](https://pyexplorer.com.br/learn): Educational articles and tutorials about Python and programming for kids.
- [About](https://pyexplorer.com.br/about): Information about the project and its goals.

## Game and User Areas

- [Game](https://pyexplorer.com.br/game): The main game area where users solve Python challenges (Requires login or guest mode).
- [Profile](https://pyexplorer.com.br/profile): User profile, progress, and settings (Requires login or guest mode).
- [Rewards](https://pyexplorer.com.br/rewards): The virtual store and achievements page (Requires login or guest mode).
- [Certificate](https://pyexplorer.com.br/certificate): Generate a custom PDF certificate upon completion.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://pyexplorer.com.br/sitemap.xml): The XML sitemap containing all indexable URLs.
